node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-4 relations excluded by Newton identities
node.statement: For an exact order-1024 root omega in any official production field, no reduced signed weight-4 polynomial P satisfies P(omega)=P(omega^3)=0. Newton's identities make the monic polynomial of the four signed roots even, forcing antipodal pairs, while distinct reduced base exponents forbid antipodal terms. Hence no official DLI production row contains a weight-4 relation at ell=2. Weights 5 through 7 there and WCL-ZONE remain open.
